$description: Canonical Christmas-noir Nakatomi heist. The default story already shipped in game.html since v1.0; this scenario pack is a no-op overlay supplied for round-trip safety with the v2.16 ?scenario=<name> loader.

ambient.label: Christmas-noir
ambient.description: Default low-pad drone with a hint of distant sleigh-bell sparkle on the ambient bus.

story_beats.act_1_open: It's Christmas Eve, 1988. Nakatomi Plaza's holiday party is in full swing on the 30th floor. Hans Gruber's tech crew has just taken the building.
story_beats.act_5_intro: The seventh seal is the last barrier. Beyond it, $640M in bearer bonds. The FBI cuts power in 12 minutes.
